methods.name: NDVI filtering method, Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM) method, and Support Vector Machine (SVM) method
methods.summary: The authors compare three conventional change detection methodologies: NDVI filtering (using ArcGIS 10.7), Spectral Angle Mapper (using QGIS 3.10 Semi-Automatic Classification Plugin), and Support Vector Machine (using Google Earth Engine). These methods use pre- and post-typhoon PlanetScope imagery to identify windthrow and landslide areas.
